meta.expect: She does not accept mechanically, does not invent Owen's availability, does not restart at her opening. She negotiates the new condition (e.g. she is present, it is not an interrogation, terms in writing).

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
Thanks for coming in. Before anything else, I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong.
Okay. Owen found out from the gradebook, on his phone, in the middle of class. What do you have, Hale?
The document history shows 612 words at 11:52 PM and 794 at 11:58 PM on October 28, in two single edits, with no earlier drafts. You can check it on my screen.
Turn the screen, Hale. I'm writing down the times and the word counts as you said them. A history shows when something was typed, so what in it shows who typed it?
The essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here is the scene.
Give me the page, Hale. I'm reading the scene myself, and I'm writing down that you say the line isn't in it. Whatever happens next, this stays off his record and it stays quiet.

I accept the private rewrite, no disciplinary finding, and written confirmation. There is one condition: Owen attends a ten-minute meeting tomorrow and explains the writing process himself. You may attend, but you cannot answer for him. Does Thursday at 8:15 work?

I'll agree to the rewrite to put this behind him, Hale. You said tomorrow, and then Thursday at 8:15, so which one is the meeting and which is the rewrite? I want the written confirmation in my inbox, with the rewrite mark replacing the zero and nothing on file, before Owen sits for either.
